q.line: Well, we drove that car all night until we got into San Anton’
stanza: Well, we drove that car all night until we got into San Anton’
And we slept near the Alamo, your skin was so tender and soft
Way down in Mexico you went out to find a doctor and you never came back
I would have gone on after you but I didn’t feel like letting my head get blown…

partner.line: I would have gone on after you but I didn’t feel like letting my head get blown…

stanza: Nae more work on Maggie's farm
Or a bunk in a Nissen hut instead

partner.line: Nae more work on Maggie's farm

stanza: Before the dam goes up at the foot of the sea
Before the New Wing of the Prison Ribbon Ceremony
Before the Star of the Morning comes looking for me
A camera pans the cocktail hour
Behind a blind of potted palms
And finds a lady in a Paris dress

partner.line: Behind a blind of potted palms
